Chat2DB Community 5.3.9-beta.2 adds reusable import format templates, resumable data imports and error-handling policies, improves transfer progress, and fixes SQL and local-file tab restoration.
3. **Import error-handling policies**: stop on invalid rows or skip them, and download rejected rows for review. Supported databases also allow duplicate-key rows to be ignored. #2991
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/OtterMind/Chat2DB/compare/v5.3.8...v5.3.9-beta.2

Chat2DB Community 5.3.8 reads, copies and exports complete large values instead of truncated previews - including for views, aggregations and tables without a primary key - adds the SQLX command line integration to Settings, and fixes table browsing and the KingbaseES procedure list.
1. **SQLX command line integration**: install, update and locate the OtterMind SQLX CLI from Settings, import the connections Chat2DB already stores, and see the Skill command an agent needs; credentials go to the child process

Chat2DB Community 5.3.7 adds in-app desktop updates for the packaged macOS, Windows and Linux builds; import preview with field mapping and per-format configuration for CSV, Excel, JSON and SQL imports plus an ultra-fast CSV import mode; an Update Time column in the table list; Oracle `EXPLAIN PLAN` results; and 31 further

Chat2DB Community 5.3.7-beta.4 is a Beta prerelease. Oracle `EXPLAIN PLAN` now returns the execution plan instead of reporting success with nothing to show; on some macOS machines a desktop update stopped after the application closed, and the update helper now runs independently of the application so the update completes and restarts into the new version; desktop installs that update by replacing the whole package no longer keep an unverified installation when an update fails, and instead restore and relaun

* Dashboard and console lists no longer fail on extreme page numbers: out-of-range requests return an empty page with accurate totals instead of an index error, far-out console pages keep their newest-first order without reversing the source list, and Dashboard infinite scrolling now follows the component lifecycle by @HandSonic in [PR #2812](https://github.com/OtterMind/Chat2DB/pull/2812) and [PR #2815](https://github.com/OtterMind/Chat2DB/pull/2815).
* JSON imports map missing fields and explicit JSON nul

* Built-in JDBC drivers can be downloaded again even when drivers are already installed. Concurrent downloads publish complete files safely, and background downloads no longer prevent application exit by @openai0229 and @HandSonic in [PR #2883](https://github.com/OtterMind/Chat2DB/pull/2883) and [PR #2687](https://github.com/OtterMind/Chat2DB/pull/2687).
* Invalid WHERE or ORDER BY expressions no longer remove the table's filter editors or its last successful result; correcting or clearing the expression al

* Choosing Save while closing an unnamed SQL draft no longer leaves the naming dialog blocked behind the close confirmation by @openai0229 in [PR #2736](https://github.com/OtterMind/Chat2DB/pull/2736).
* Large local-file contents are no longer copied into browser local storage, preventing quota failures while preserving restoration from disk by @openai0229 in [PR #2866](https://github.com/OtterMind/Chat2DB/pull/2866).
* Desktop close, restart, and update operations now wait for editor save handling with a n

# v5.6.2

The primary focus of this release is the server link update for the HeiGIT ohsomeNow API. This release also includes critical UX bug fixes for the iD editor and OSM authentication, dependency updates, and infrastructure enhancements.

## What's Changed
* docs: replace dead service desk link with roadmap tech-request page by @sumitdahal7 in https://github.com/hotosm/tasking-manager/pull/7336
* fix: load the project's imagery in the embedded iD editor on first load by @sumitdahal7 in https://g
